evidence.name: Screen field: How rounded the image is
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How rounded the image is" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How rounded the image is
sections.description: Rounds all four corners of the hero image; 0 is sharp and higher values (up to 50) make them softer and more rounded. The default is 0. A small radius around 8 to 16 gives a modern, friendly look; match it to the rounding used elsewhere in your funnel, like buttons and cards, so the page feels consistent.
